rationale: Documentation edit across three files, no code paths touched, low ambiguity and low blast radius. local-code-fast is the cheapest local profile with the smallest cold start; it guarantees chat only, which is all this needs. cluster-only because the attempt should not depend on a workstation being awake. Empty fallbacks is deliberate: if the cluster GPU is unavailable this attempt should fail and be re-planned rather than consume subscription capacity a harder story will want.
